=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/alert-triage.yml:143-150 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Diagnose groups" step env sets only ALERT_TRIAGE_MODEL, CODEX_VERSION and SUPPORT_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE and does not pass OPENROUTER_API_KEY, which the codex fallback requires: `scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:504` runs `fail "OPENROUTER_API_KEY is required by the host-side broker"`.
  WHY: Until the broker Worker is redeployed, every ALERT_TRIAGE call takes the codex path (AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY=always), so each group ends as `engine_failed` and is escalated without a diagnosis. With ALERT_TRIAGE_DRY_RUN=false this sends an hourly Telegram escalation per group, and no alert is ever classified or routed. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:263-266 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_ALERT_TRIAGE_WORKFLOW_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9 ._:/()\[\]#@+-]{1,200}$")` excludes `&` and `,`, but real display names contain them (`.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2 name: Test & Mark Stable Release`, `.github/workflows/internal-review.yml:1 name: "Internal: AI Review & Autofix"`).
  WHY: `scripts/alert_triage.py:679-680` decide_group() escalates healable groups from such workflows as `healable_bad_workflow_name`, and validate_payload() (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3012`) rejects them at intake, so auto-heal can never fire for test-and-mark-stable.yml, which is not in pipeline_self_files. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:432-437,477-486,737,824-830 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When there are no valid groups, prepare() skips the list calls (`if groups:`) but `lists_ok` stays True and `tracking["open_ids"]` becomes []. decide() passes [] through, and apply() filters every key out of ledger/escalated_items.json and rewrites it as `{"items": {}}`.
  WHY: Any quiet hour that commits something wipes the escalate-once ledger flags, so the next run with alerts re-escalates every still-open aged ai:alert-triage issue and ai:alert-self-fix PR. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:432-439,449-470 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `list_open_items()` returns None on API failure, `heal_items or []` / `fix_items or []` turns it into an empty list, and `tracked` / `needs_model` never consult `lists_ok`, so every group looks untracked.
  WHY: A transient GitHub API error hides existing heal issues and self-fix PRs, so already-tracked groups are re-diagnosed and can be dispatched again (a duplicate self-fix run, bounded only by the 2-in-7-days cap). All reviewers rated this MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 to 5.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:887-893 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: build_self_fix_body() clears only proposed_fix and evidence, then slices the serialized JSON with `compact = json.dumps(trimmed, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)[:DIAGNOSIS_MAX_BYTES]`, which can cut through the middle of a JSON value.
  WHY: Validated diagnoses can still exceed 16 KiB through decisions and files, so the `diagnosis` workflow_dispatch input to alert-self-fix.yml is invalid JSON and the consumer's json.loads fails. test_build_self_fix_body_caps_the_diagnosis checks only the byte length. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/alert_triage_route.sh:349-381 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: at_route() commits and pushes the done markers and the dispatch-attempt ledger entries (written by apply(), `scripts/alert_triage.py:800-815`) through `_at_commit_and_push` (line 360) before the heal/self-fix dispatch loop (line 368) and the escalation loop run.
  WHY: If the job is cancelled, the runner dies or a dispatch fails after the push, the records are already marked done (`done_keys` filter), no pending route is kept, and the dispatch or escalation is lost for good. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (narrow window, intentional at-most-once design); the other four rated it MAJOR, and the highest is used.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:~178 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: recent_attempts() uses `(parse_time(item.get("at")) or cutoff) > cutoff`, so an attempt with an unparseable timestamp is silently dropped instead of being counted conservatively.
  WHY: A corrupt or hand-edited ledger/<fp>.json undercounts attempts and can allow one dispatch beyond the 2-in-7-days cap (fail-open on the cap). Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/alert-triage.yml:"Diagnose groups" step env (sets only ALERT_TRIAGE_MODEL, CODEX_VERSION and SUPPORT_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: OPENROUTER_API_KEY is missing. scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh line 504 fails the call: `[ "${engine}" = claude ] || [ -n "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY:-}" ] || fail "OPENROUTER_API_KEY is required by the host-side broker"`. .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml line 269 passes `OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}`.
  WHY: `_at_run_engine` returns non-zero, so every group gets `outcome=engine_failed` and decide_group escalates it. No alert is classified, and with DRY_RUN=false Telegram escalations go out hourly. Fix: add the secret to the Diagnose groups step env only.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:prepare() `lists_ok = True`, list calls inside `if groups:`; decide() open_ids; apply() filter and rewrite of ledger/escalated_items.json | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: With no valid groups the lists are never fetched, but lists_ok stays True and open_ids is [], so apply() writes `{"items": {}}`.
  WHY: After a quiet hour all flags are lost and the next run with alerts escalates every item again. Fix: set lists_ok False or open_ids None when the lists were not fetched, or always make the list calls.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:build_self_fix_body() `compact = json.dumps(trimmed, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)[:DIAGNOSIS_MAX_BYTES]` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only proposed_fix and evidence are cleared. Summary, decisions (about 30 KB) and files (about 10 KB) can still exceed 16 KiB, and the slice cuts in the middle of a string.
  WHY: The diagnosis input is invalid JSON, so the Phase 3 consumer's parse fails, and the test checks only the length. Fix: clear decisions and files and serialize again, then guard with json.loads and TriageError("diagnosis").
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:`_ALERT_TRIAGE_WORKFLOW_NAME_RE` (used by validate_payload() and alert_triage.py decide_group()) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The regex excludes `&`, which appears in `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2 name: Test & Mark Stable Release` and `.github/workflows/internal-review.yml:1 name: "Internal: AI Review & Autofix"`.
  WHY: Healable groups from test-and-mark-stable.yml are always escalated as `healable_bad_workflow_name`. Fix: add `&` and `,` to the allowed characters.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:prepare() list_open_items / `lists_ok = heal_items is not None and fix_items is not None` / `heal_items or []` / `"tracked"`, `needs_model` ignore lists_ok | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed list call is treated as "no open items", so every group looks untracked.
  WHY: After an API error, groups with an open self-fix PR or heal issue are dispatched again. Fix: when lists_ok is False, set needs_model False and record the route as `deferred`.
- scripts/alert_triage_route.sh:at_route() `_at_commit_and_push` before the dispatch and escalation loops | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The at-most-once design marks records done before the side effects run.
  WHY: If the job is cancelled or times out after the push, dispatches and escalations are lost silently. The window is narrow.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Escalate, once per item via a ledger flag: ai:alert-triage issues open longer than ALERT_TRIAGE_ISSUE_ESCALATE_HOURS (default 24); ai:alert-self-fix PRs open longer than ALERT_TRIAGE_PR_ESCALATE_HOURS (default 6)." Plan (docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md lines 335-338): "Each run also re-checks open ai:alert-triage issues and ai:alert-self-fix PRs from the same list calls and escalates"
  Expected change site: scripts/alert_triage.py prepare(), the list calls behind `if groups:` and the tracking computation.
  Evidence of absence: The list calls run only when new valid groups exist, and test_second_run_on_the_same_record
